title: Compose safe-area content and one genuinely blocking focused-glass overlay
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md and your frozen export contract in docs/PILOT100_UI_CONTRACTS.md before coding. Implement only your owned leaf module using installed React/TypeScript/testing dependencies. Export the exact named component and readonly props/types from index.tsx; keep module-local styles and tests inside that directory. Do not import an unmerged A/B task, edit App.tsx/shared barrels/manifests/task metadata or silently change another contract. This is controlled recipient-safe presentation, not an authority or complete application. Authority state/capabilities and semantic callbacks are supplied; no Firebase/native/store/network calls, secret caching, clock-driven game transitions, asset generation or fabricated success. Use original neutral-frost chrome, semantic HTML/keyboard access and honest unavailable media/provider states. Overlay leaves supply content to the separately composed modal host; do not claim global focus blocking in a content-only leaf. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, credentials, cloud deployment or budget changes. Preserve concise handoff, observed validation/failures and unknown costs under the benchmark policy. Implement the generic composition host using slot props only. The entire background receives uniform blur,dim,desaturation and inertness under one overlay; contain focus,announce its title,restore previous focus on close/unmount and allow Escape only when dismissible. Keep a persistent dock slot above safe area without making underlying gameplay interactive. No B sibling import is needed. Own only apps/client/src/pilot100/modal-viewport/; provide index.tsx exporting ModalViewport, ModalViewportProps and any named local types documented for B050. This task consumes part of A026, A048, A089; do not double-count it as a second implementation of that broad work. Run scoped React tests/lint/typecheck and node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; report actual results and unresolved application integration.
acceptance: Opening a dialog traps keyboard focus,labels it and blocks pointer/focus/assistive interaction with the entire background.
Closing/removing/unmounting restores focus and prior inert/style state; nondismissible Escape does not bypass mandatory decisions.
Safe-area/reserved-dock layout remains usable with long content/reduced motion and exactly one overlay,without pausing authority or mutating inputs.
Exact frozen export/readonly props are implemented and scoped lint/typecheck/meaningful React tests plus node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full pass; only owned files change.
